title: Invite a teammate to your client workspace
audience: A client administrator receiving a consultant handover.
prerequisites: Use a workspace where you are authorized to manage members. This example uses a fictional UI; labels may differ in your actual product.

steps.expected: The member list and Invite member action are visible.
steps.observed: The synthetic screenshot shows two current members and an invitation button.
steps.capture_note: Fictional UI fixture; no live account action or email delivery was performed.

steps.action: Enter the recipient and review the Editor role
steps.expected: The intended email and access role are set before the invitation is sent.
steps.observed: The synthetic draft has an email value and the Editor role selected; it is not yet sent.
steps.capture_note: Fictional UI fixture; no live account action or email delivery was performed.

steps.action: Send the invitation and check its pending status
steps.expected: The intended recipient appears with the Editor role and a Pending status.
steps.observed: The synthetic final state shows Editor and Pending. It does not establish acceptance or actual delivery.
steps.capture_note: Fictional UI fixture; no live account action or email delivery was performed.
